meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把 Slack 工作区接进系统:准备程序代码、要求你创建 Slack 应用并提供密钥,然后重启服务。完成后,你就能在 Slack 里直接和 Claude 对话了。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Slack 频道、连接 Slack 工作区,或让机器人在 Slack 中可用时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Slack,用 Socket 模式。
say.note: 将以 Socket Mode 配置 Slack 事件接收。

say.text: 把 Slack 接进来,用 webhook 方式。
say.note: 将引导设置公开 URL 和事件订阅。

say.text: 给 Claude 添加 Slack 频道集成。
say.note: 执行完整的 Slack 接入流程。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack support via the Chat SDK. Copies and registers the Slack adapter, installs dependencies, builds, validates, then guides creating a Slack app, choosing Socket or webhook, collecting credentials, and restarting. Claude can then chat over Slack.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Slack integration, connect a Slack workspace, or enable Slack messaging.

say_en.text: Set up Slack for me using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Configures Slack event delivery via Socket Mode.
Walks through webhook URL and event subscriptions.

say_en.text: Enable Slack channel integration for Claude.
say_en.note: Runs the full Slack integration flow.
